label.purpose: Short fact labels and supporting notes.

numeric.purpose: Machine values, measurements and tabular data.

metric.purpose: Inline session and calibration summary values.

motion.name: route-emphasis
motion.purpose: Branch dimming when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: refresh-busy
motion.purpose: Rotation while refreshing; removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Outlined action
components.description: The default pill action, with control-tone hover and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-action{color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif);border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;padding:7px 13px;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;}.ds-action:hover:not(:disabled):not([aria-disabled=true]){background:var(--usage-control, #332b24)}.ds-action:disabled,.ds-action[aria-disabled=true]{cursor:default;color:var(--usage-muted, #c4b7a8)}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--usage-focus-ring, #f3eadb);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Selected toggle
components.description: A compact selected choice inside a segmented unit control.
components.css: .ds-segmented{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);border-radius:999px;padding:3px}.ds-segmented button{color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif);border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;padding:7px 13px;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;min-height:30px;padding:4px 12px;border-color:transparent;color:var(--usage-muted, #c4b7a8)}.ds-segmented button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--usage-control, #332b24);color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);border-color:var(--usage-border, #493d33)}.ds-segmented button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--usage-control, #332b24)}.ds-segmented button:disabled{cursor:default;color:var(--usage-muted, #c4b7a8)}.ds-segmented button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--usage-focus-ring, #f3eadb);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Date-time field
components.description: A labeled native date-time input for a custom range.
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-field{background:var(--usage-surface, #201a16);color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;caret-color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-code, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--usage-focus-ring, #f3eadb);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Page navigation
components.description: Outlined page actions with an ink border on the current page.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Usage pages"><button type="button" aria-current="page">Overview</button><button type="button">Calibration & data</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.ds-nav button{color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif);border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;padding:7px 13px;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--usage-muted, #c4b7a8);white-space:nowrap}.ds-nav button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--usage-control, #332b24);color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb)}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{border-color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);font-weight:500}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--usage-focus-ring, #f3eadb);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:1350px){.ds-nav button{padding:6px 10px;font-size:13px}}

components.name: Fact chip
components.description: A noninteractive compact fact, not a filter action.
components.css: .ds-fact{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 12px;min-height:36px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--usage-muted, #c4b7a8);font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-fact-value{font-family:var(--usage-code, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Correction status
components.description: A labeled correction state with a small dot and matching outline.
components.css: .ds-status{border:1px solid var(--usage-model-sage, #8fbf8a);color:var(--usage-model-sage, #8fbf8a);border-radius:999px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 11px;font:500 13px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif);white-space:nowrap;min-height:32px}.ds-status::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;background:currentColor;border-radius:50%}@media(max-width:1350px){.ds-status{font-size:12px;padding:5px 8px}}

components.name: Section panel
components.description: A ground-toned evidence section with one thin enclosing outline.
components.css: .ds-panel{border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);border-radius:12px;background:var(--usage-ground, #16120f);color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);padding:24px;font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-panel h2{margin:0;font-size:20px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:500}.ds-panel p{margin:0;padding:20px 0;color:var(--usage-muted, #c4b7a8)}

components.name: Pace track
components.description: Synthetic geometry demonstrates the solid use fill, hatched projection and current-point ring.
components.html: <button class="ds-pace" type="button" aria-label="Monthly credit pace details"><svg class="ds-pace-track" viewBox="0 0 1000 40" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><defs><pattern id="ds-pace-hatch" width="10" height="10" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(30)"><path class="ds-pace-hatch" d="M0 0v10" stroke-width="3"/></pattern></defs><rect x="450" y="0" width="270" height="40" fill="url(#ds-pace-hatch)"/><rect class="ds-pace-fill" width="450" height="40"/><circle class="ds-pace-ring" cx="450" cy="20" r="9" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/></svg></button>

components.name: Session route
components.description: Synthetic branches show model markers, line patterns and focus emphasis. These shapes are not usage records.
components.html: <svg class="ds-route" viewBox="0 0 800 430" role="group" aria-label="Example session route"><path class="ds-route-baseline" d="M78 214H772"/><g class="ds-branch" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Example circle model run"><path class="ds-route-casing" d="M120 214l7-7V115l7-7h142l7 7v92l7 7"/><path class="ds-route-ink ds-route-tomato" d="M120 214l7-7V115l7-7h142l7 7v92l7 7"/><circle class="ds-route-circle" cx="205" cy="108" r="3"/><circle class="ds-route-end" cx="290" cy="214" r="4"/></g><g class="ds-branch" tabindex="-1" role="button" aria-label="Example diamond model run"><path class="ds-route-casing" d="M360 214l7 7v67l7 7h172l7-7v-67l7-7"/><path class="ds-route-ink ds-route-sky" d="M360 214l7 7v67l7 7h172l7-7v-67l7-7"/><path class="ds-route-diamond" d="M460 291l4 4-4 4-4-4Z"/><circle class="ds-route-end" cx="560" cy="214" r="4"/></g></svg>

components.name: Route detail card
components.description: An opaque chart detail card with labels and aligned machine values.
components.css: .ds-route-card{width:310px;border:1px solid var(--usage-border, #493d33);border-radius:12px;background:var(--usage-control, #332b24);color:var(--usage-ink, #f3eadb);padding:14px 17px;font:400 14px/1.5 var(--usage-text, 'Fira Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-route-card h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:16px;font-weight:500}.ds-card-model{font-family:var(--usage-code, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace);font-size:12px;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-route-card dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:4px;margin:0}.ds-route-card dt{color:var(--usage-muted, #c4b7a8)}.ds-route-card dd{margin:0;font-family:var(--usage-code, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace);font-size:12px;text-align:right}

narrative.overview:
This system describes the usage web interface. Brown-black backgrounds and pale text provide a quiet setting for dense measurements. Outlined controls, short labels and aligned numbers keep the interface readable without separating every fact into a card.

Charts carry the visual identity. Session activity follows a horizontal baseline with colored branches, while stacked bars and connecting ribbons show attribution. Color, marker shape and line pattern distinguish data; they do not decorate the surrounding panels. The wordmark is condensed, but headings and controls remain ordinary reading text.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark surfaces with pale, high-contrast text.
Thin outlines and rounded panels, with pills for controls and compact facts.
Separate color families for models and participant roles.
Direct chart interaction with an equivalent table view.

rules.name: The Attribution Rule
rules.body: Model colors identify models; role colors identify participants. Preserve that distinction when both appear in the same chart.

rules.name: The State Needs Context Rule
rules.body: A colored status mark accompanies a label or accessible description. Tomato alone does not distinguish a model from a warning.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Use the code family for machine values and measurements, not as a substitute for the interface's reading face. Keep tabular numerals in data columns.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone, outline and stacking to establish hierarchy. Do not add decorative shadows to the existing panel and control vocabulary.

dos: **Do** use warm neutral surfaces and reserve data colors for attribution and meaningful states.
**Do** pair model color with marker shape and keep participant-role colors separate.
**Do** align comparable numeric values and use the code family for measurements, identifiers and times.
**Do** keep chart and table representations together with visible keyboard focus.
**Do** show missing data with an explicit label rather than a fabricated amount or series.
**Do** keep public examples synthetic and free of account details or user paths.
donts: **Don't** turn every summary value into a separate card or nest content panels inside panels.
**Don't** add shadows, decorative gradients or translucent glass to this flat interface.
**Don't** use the wordmark face for ordinary headings or controls.
**Don't** rely on color alone to communicate model identity, status or selection.
**Don't** remove chart patterns, neutral dividers or outlines merely to make the interface more minimal.
**Don't** promise a mobile layout that the desktop implementation does not provide.
